findings.explanation: Ownership of your work transfers to the client immediately upon creation or delivery rather than waiting for full payment, creating the risk that you lose your rights before being paid.
findings.suggested_change: Ownership of the Incorporated Technology Works shall transfer to the Client only upon receipt of full payment for such works.

content.body: Hello, thank you for sending over the agreement. I just have one quick note before signing: - Regarding the relevant clause, ownership transfers immediately instead of waiting for full payment, and I propose that ownership shall transfer to the client only upon receipt of full payment for such works. Thank you and best regards,
